amy_sales: Hey team — ACME infra just asked for a preflight plan. They want a short POC focused on KMS/BYO-HSM throughput + rotation during cutover. Can we confirm steps and any billing implications?
mike_se: I can own the test plan. Quick Q: are they doing persistent BYO-HSM or egress-only proxy to our keystore?
cust_infra: we'll be hands-on with our HSM, but we need a proxy option if latency spikes. Goal: validate 10k encrypt ops/min with <50ms median key lookup.
mike_se: OK. Plan: 1) whitelist IPs + perf baseline 2) run `redis`-backed warmup + joint load 3) perform a controlled rotation window where we swap CMKs and validate traffic fallback.
amy_sales: Is the rotation window going to trigger extra billing? Customer asked how reserved capacity vs overage is billed during rotation.
crypto_ops_bot: Note: HSM operations (sign/decrypt) are billed per-op on our end when we proxy. For Dedicated reserved capacity, we prorate baseline; additional HSM-proxy egress calls are billed at metered rate.
lisa_legal: Also flag the audit trail requirement — they need attestation logs for every rotation event (ISO/PCI expectations). We'll include that in SOW.
raj_eng: For the perf test, we'll provide a lightweight harness `kms-load` (python) that hits the proxy with parallelism. Sample command:```bash
./kms-load --target https://proxy.acme.redwood --concurrency 200 --ops 600000
```
mike_se: Network reqs: customer must open outbound to our proxy IPs and allow TLS mutual-auth (client cert). We'll hand over CA fingerprints.
cust_infra: On rotation, we need a failback policy where requests use previous version for 2 min before hard cut. Can Redwood support TTL-based key fallback?
raj_eng: Yes, policy `grace_period_ms` exists in config; default 120000ms. We'll add an extra safety check: on first failed decrypt we'll route to cached previous KEK for 2 min.
amy_sales: Pricing note to confirm for sales: if they run the POC and then convert to Dedicated next month, do we credit POC metered usage toward commit?
crypto_ops_bot: Standard: POC metered usage may be eligible for credit up to first-month commit if pre-approved by Sales Ops. Need SKU approval.
lisa_legal: Add SLA exceptions in SOW for HSM third-party network outages — mark as force majeure for cutover windows.
mike_se: Action items: @raj_eng create perf harness + sample TLS cert bundle, @amy_sales confirm SKU approval for credit, @cust_infra share firewall egress manifest by EOD Friday.
amy_sales: I'll loop in Sales Ops now. Thanks. :thumbsup:
cust_infra: Sending firewall list in 30m. Also attaching their security questionnaire later — expect some Qs on attestation CA chain.
raj_eng: Noted. I'll prep attestation example outputs and a small `rotation-check` script to validate logs. Output format will be JSON-lines, e.g.:```json
{"time":"2026-03-23T15:00:00Z","event":"rotation_started","cmk":"cmk-acme-01","initiator":"acme-hsm"}
```
mike_se: Perfect. If customer wants a dry-run rotation during off-hours, we can do it w/o billing if we throttle ops under an agreed cap. Need sales approval.
amy_sales: Filing for approval now. Will update once Sales Ops confirms.
amy_sales: Closing thread for now — will reopen if any blockers.
